_comment: Pre-flight P1 (docs/experiment-spec-book.md section 6.0). Committed 2026-07-29 so 26-of-31 colliding spec ids and their seed assignments cannot silently merge result files. Resolves Q2 (seed 909 collision) with the doc's own recommended default (a).
_source: docs/experiment-spec-book.md sections 6.0 and 6, section 8 Q2 -- cross-checked against benchmark/score_selectors.py's enforced BURNED_SEEDS and the dynamic original_audit_seeds() filename scan.
_discrepancy_found_2026-07-29: spec-book section 6.0's prose lists seed 3 as burned ('Burned, never reusable: 3, 7, 42, ...'). No committed result file anywhere uses seed=3, and original_audit_seeds()'s dynamic scan does not find it either -- score_selectors.BURNED_SEEDS (the actual enforced list) correctly omits it. This registry follows the CODE, not the doc's prose, since the doc appears to have a transcription error. Flagging for a spec-book correction; not fixed here to avoid conflating a live-run registry commit with an unrelated doc edit.

instability_merged.note: Kept 909 as first mover in the collision (Q2 default a) -- the merge with SCI-1's restate_probe is deliberate and shares one control triple.

seeds.note: No task-sample seed -- explicit task lists. Per-trial model seeds derived into 10000-99999.

selection_pools.note: Renumbered from a 909 collision claim per Q2 default (a). Matches benchmark/score_selectors.py's own S7 CLI example and the 411/523/631 pools already referenced in this repo's run queue.

seeds.note: 101/202/303 stay with the SEL pools per Q2; MATH-6's SuperGPQA sc_mc screen and MATH-4 (dropped) renumber away from 909. MATH-1's own liveness screen uses 101 directly (docs/experiment-spec-book.md section 6.2 item 1) -- if MATH-6 genuinely needs the same 90 items as META-2, run ONE shared control arm and label it shared in both write-ups rather than double-counting, per Q2's closing note.

compute_matched_control.note: MUST match flagship_panel's own seeds exactly -- this is a paired control, not a fresh screen. See benchmark/run_compute_matched_control.py.

chemistry_matched_baselines.note: Completes chem_thinking_gate's 3-seed comparison (314 already matched). 217/314/471 are in burned_never_reusable for S7 SELECTOR-SHIPPING purposes only (score_selectors.assert_seeds_not_burned is scoped to --ship-gate); reusing them here to pair with an EXISTING engine run at the same seed is the intended use, not a violation.

universal_gate.note: GPQA first per benchmark/results/unanimous_gate_headroom.md (4.2 escalations/net item vs SuperGPQA's 24.0). Assigned 2026-07-29, confirmed unburned and unused.
